result.rationale: In the updateEvent/deleteEvent fallback: `const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;` — the find only runs when externalCalendarId is falsy, so comparing cal.externalId === externalCalendarId (undefined/null) can never match, making the fallback always undefined. The old code returned `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` as fallback, so this is a regression introducing dead fallback logic.
